title: Annual General Meeting 2026 — Save the Date
summary: Join us this June at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Centre as we review the year, vote on resolutions, and unveil our 2026-2030 roadmap.
summaryMs: Sertai kami pada bulan Jun di Pusat Konvensyen Kuala Lumpur untuk semakan tahunan, undian resolusi, dan pelan tindakan 2026-2030.
body:
Koperasi VX Berhad is pleased to invite all members to our 32nd Annual General Meeting. This year's agenda includes the FY2025 financial review, dividend declaration, election of three new board positions, and the unveiling of our five-year strategic plan.

Members attending in person will receive a commemorative member gift. Online participation is fully supported via the VX app starting from this release, including live voting and Q&A.

Light refreshments will be served. Doors open at 8:30am.
bodyMs:
Koperasi VX Berhad dengan sukacitanya menjemput semua ahli ke Mesyuarat Agung Tahunan ke-32. Agenda tahun ini termasuk semakan kewangan FY2025, pengisytiharan dividen, pemilihan tiga jawatan lembaga baharu, dan pelancaran pelan strategik lima tahun.

Ahli yang hadir secara fizikal akan menerima hadiah peringatan. Penyertaan dalam talian disokong sepenuhnya melalui aplikasi VX, termasuk undian langsung dan sesi soal jawab.

Makanan ringan akan disediakan. Pintu dibuka pada 8.30 pagi.
author: Encik Faizal Mohd, Setiausaha

title: Q1 2026 Dividend Declared at 6.2%
summary: The board has approved a Q1 dividend of 6.2% on member shares, payable from 1 June. View your projected payout in the Shares tab.
summaryMs: Lembaga meluluskan dividen Q1 sebanyak 6.2% atas syer ahli, dibayar mulai 1 Jun. Lihat bayaran anggaran dalam tab Syer.
body:
Following a strong first quarter driven by our marketplace expansion and operational efficiency gains, the board of Koperasi VX Berhad has declared a Q1 2026 dividend of 6.2% — our highest first-quarter rate in five years.

Dividends will be credited directly to your registered bank account between 1 and 7 June. You can view your projected payout in real time under the Shares & Dividends tab.

For questions, reach out via the Enquiry module or visit the member service counter at HQ.
bodyMs:
Selepas suku pertama yang kukuh didorong oleh pengembangan pasar raya dan kecekapan operasi, lembaga Koperasi VX Berhad mengisytiharkan dividen Q1 2026 sebanyak 6.2% — kadar tertinggi suku pertama dalam tempoh lima tahun.

Dividen akan dikreditkan terus ke akaun bank berdaftar antara 1 hingga 7 Jun. Anda boleh melihat anggaran bayaran secara langsung di tab Syer & Dividen.

Untuk pertanyaan, hubungi melalui modul Pertanyaan atau kaunter perkhidmatan ahli di ibu pejabat.
author: Datin Sarah Lee, Bendahari

title: New Member Marketplace Goes Live
titleMs: Pasar Raya Ahli Baharu Kini Aktif
summary: Browse and shop from over 60 member-owned vendors across food, fashion, and home goods — with exclusive member pricing.
summaryMs: Layari dan beli dari lebih 60 vendor milik ahli di kategori makanan, fesyen, dan barangan rumah — dengan harga ahli eksklusif.
body:
We're thrilled to launch the Koperasi VX Marketplace — a curated platform where members can both shop and sell. From day one, more than 60 member-owned businesses are onboard, with categories spanning fresh produce, fashion, electronics, and home goods.

All members receive a 5% discount on every order, plus free delivery within Klang Valley on orders above RM150. Vendors retain 92% of every sale; the remaining contributes to a member solidarity fund that supports cooperative scholarships.

Visit the Marketplace tab to start exploring.
bodyMs:
Kami dengan sukacita melancarkan Pasar Raya Koperasi VX — platform terpilih di mana ahli boleh membeli dan menjual. Dari hari pertama, lebih 60 perniagaan milik ahli telah menyertai, dengan kategori merangkumi hasil tani segar, fesyen, elektronik, dan barangan rumah.

Semua ahli menerima diskaun 5% pada setiap pesanan, ditambah dengan penghantaran percuma di sekitar Lembah Klang untuk pesanan melebihi RM150. Vendor menyimpan 92% dari setiap jualan; baki menyumbang kepada dana solidariti ahli yang menyokong biasiswa koperasi.

Lawati tab Pasar Raya untuk mula meneroka.
author: Puan Aishah Ibrahim, COO

title: Financial Literacy Workshop — Free for Members
titleMs: Bengkel Literasi Kewangan — Percuma untuk Ahli
summary: A two-day intensive on budgeting, halal investing, and retirement planning — led by certified financial planners.
summaryMs: Sesi intensif dua hari mengenai bajet, pelaburan halal, dan perancangan persaraan — dikendalikan oleh perancang kewangan bertauliah.
body:
Save Saturday 22 and Sunday 23 June for our annual financial literacy weekend. The two-day program covers personal budgeting fundamentals, halal investment principles, EPF optimization, and retirement planning specifically tailored for cooperative members.

Four certified financial planners will lead the sessions, with one-on-one consultation slots available throughout. Lunch and refreshments are provided. Limited to 80 members — register through the Events tab.
bodyMs:
Catat tarikh Sabtu 22 dan Ahad 23 Jun untuk hujung minggu literasi kewangan tahunan kami. Program dua hari merangkumi asas bajet peribadi, prinsip pelaburan halal, pengoptimuman KWSP, dan perancangan persaraan khusus untuk ahli koperasi.

Empat perancang kewangan bertauliah akan mengendalikan sesi, dengan slot konsultasi satu-satu tersedia. Makan tengah hari dan minuman ringan disediakan. Terhad kepada 80 ahli — daftar melalui tab Acara.
author: Encik Hafiz Ramli, Pendidikan

title: Welcoming 1,200 New Members This Quarter
summary: Our community continues to grow. Thank you to every member who referred a friend or family member this quarter.
summaryMs: Komuniti kami terus berkembang. Terima kasih kepada setiap ahli yang merujuk rakan atau keluarga suku ini.
body:
We crossed another milestone this quarter — 1,200 new members joined Koperasi VX, bringing total active membership above 47,000. A heartfelt thank you to the 380 existing members who referred friends, family, and colleagues.

Referring members will receive a bonus share allocation credited at the end of the month, in line with our Member-Refer-Member program.
bodyMs:
Kami mencapai tahap baharu suku ini — 1,200 ahli baharu menyertai Koperasi VX, menjadikan jumlah keahlian aktif melebihi 47,000. Terima kasih ikhlas kepada 380 ahli sedia ada yang merujuk rakan, keluarga, dan rakan sekerja.

Ahli yang merujuk akan menerima peruntukan syer bonus pada akhir bulan, selaras dengan program Ahli-Rujuk-Ahli.
author: Komunikasi Koperasi
